description: Defines the interface for a DatagramClientSocket class used for UDP socket communication in the Chromium project, including connection methods, network binding, socket tagging, and configuration options.

classes.name: DatagramClientSocket
classes.description: Interface for a UDP datagram socket client, supporting connection, network binding, socket tagging, and multicast configuration.

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: Initializes socket as a client to a server at the specified address; can only be called once.

methods.name: ConnectUsingNetwork
methods.description: Binds socket to a specific network and address; can only be called once.

methods.name: ConnectUsingDefaultNetwork
methods.description: Uses the default network to connect to the specified address; can only be called once.

methods.name: ConnectAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous or synchronous connection to an address with callback.

methods.name: ConnectUsingNetworkAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous or synchronous network-specific connection with callback.

methods.name: ConnectUsingDefaultNetworkAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous or synchronous default network connection with callback.

methods.name: GetBoundNetwork
methods.description: Returns the network handle the socket is bound to.

methods.name: ApplySocketTag
methods.description: Applies a socket tag for network traffic identification.

methods.name: EnableRecvOptimization
methods.description: Enables experimental receive optimization (no-op by default).

methods.name: SetMulticastInterface
methods.description: Sets the interface for multicast traffic.

methods.name: SetIOSNetworkServiceType
methods.description: Sets the iOS network service type (no-op by default).
